research_mode: official Police.uk sources only; outcome-history, person-linkage and street-outcome coverage controls; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Specific-crime outcome history
verified_claims: the method returns a list of outcome categories and dates for one persistent crime ID
limitations: history availability depends on the supplying force and API coverage

sources.name: Outcome-history identifier
verified_claims: the request uses the 64-character persistent crime identifier
limitations: ordinary API crime id must not be substituted

sources.name: PSNI outcome unavailability
verified_claims: crime outcomes are not available for the Police Service of Northern Ireland
limitations: missing PSNI outcomes are a coverage limitation, not zero outcomes

sources.name: Outcome code and name
verified_claims: each outcome category includes an internal code and human-readable name
limitations: display names should not replace stable codes in joins

sources.name: Outcome date granularity
verified_claims: outcome dates are returned at year-month granularity
limitations: month values are not exact decision timestamps

sources.name: Nullable outcome person identifier
verified_claims: person_id identifies a suspect or offender where available and can be null
limitations: null must not be converted into a synthetic person

sources.name: Under-investigation outcome
verified_claims: under-investigation is an official outcome-history category
limitations: it is a status, not a final disposal

sources.name: Status-update-unavailable outcome
verified_claims: status-update-unavailable is an official outcome category
limitations: it must not be interpreted as no police action

sources.name: No-suspect outcome category
verified_claims: no-further-action maps to Investigation complete; no suspect identified
limitations: the category is not equivalent to crime invalidation

sources.name: Unable-to-prosecute category
verified_claims: unable-to-prosecute is a distinct outcome category
limitations: the API category does not expose the full evidential reason

sources.name: Street outcomes by location ID
verified_claims: street outcomes can be requested for a specific mapped location ID and month
limitations: location ID is an anonymised map location, not a property identifier

sources.name: Street outcomes by point
verified_claims: street outcomes can be requested around a latitude-longitude point
limitations: point mode is approximate and area-based

sources.name: Street outcomes by polygon
verified_claims: street outcomes can be requested within a custom polygon
limitations: polygon construction and edition month must be retained

sources.name: Outcome custom-area ceiling
verified_claims: custom areas containing more than 10000 outcomes return HTTP 503
limitations: 503 at the volume ceiling is not no-data evidence

sources.name: Embedded crime in outcome response
verified_claims: street-outcome records include related crime information and outcome category details
